title: Flower / Chinese-language animation

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Add motion around a stable message so attention can increase without making the words hard to follow.
strategic_value: A rotating textured flower can supply expressive movement while Wise’s headline and qualification remain readable.
demonstration: A textured flower turns on a purple landscape field beside large vertical Chinese text; a smaller vertical qualification sits at right above the Wise signature.
practical_value: Compare moving imagery with fixed text and preserve the qualification when changing format.

content_islands.name: Main message and flower
content_islands.spec: Place the large vertical headline at left beside the moving flower.

content_islands.name: Qualification and signature
content_islands.spec: Keep the smaller vertical text at the right and the logo below it.

reference_purposes.Expression: A textured flower turns on a purple landscape field beside large vertical Chinese text; a smaller vertical qualification sits at right above the Wise signature.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates an animated campaign with fixed main text, qualification and signature.
